'''Seltarii Skycloud''' is a [[night elf]] reagents and poison vendor located at [[Narvalis Point]] in [[Moonwhisper Coast]].

==Quotes==
;Gossip
I used to live in Nendis many moons ago, even well before the Third War. Much has changed since then, but there is one thing that's perplexing me to this day. The resilience of the Tauren people, those two tribes that settled here so long ago. Frankly, I hadn't expected them to survive here for that long, but I was proven different. To my shame, I must admit. Now I see that such hubris is not befitting of me.
